entries.name: dual_rail_subscription
entries.sql:
-- Dual-Rail Subscription: Google Play Billing + Midtrans
-- Target: PostgreSQL / Supabase
-- Safe design goals:
--   * Subscription entitlements are server authoritative.
--   * No is_premium flag in SQLite.
--   * Play purchase tokens and Midtrans order IDs are unique/idempotent.
--   * Device binding is enforced transactionally in PostgreSQL.
--   * Grace period is fixed at 3 days unless explicitly changed here.
--   * Existing POS/COA tables are not touched.

begin;

create extension if not exists pgcrypto;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Utility trigger
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create or replace function public.set_updated_at()
returns trigger
language plpgsql
as $$
begin
  new.updated_at = now();
  return new;
end;
$$;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Plans
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create table if not exists public.plans (
  plan_id text primary key,
  name text not null,
  description text,
  price_idr_direct integer not null check (price_idr_direct >= 0),
  play_product_id text unique,
  duration_days integer not null default 30 check (duration_days > 0),
  max_devices integer not null default 1 check (max_devices > 0),
  features jsonb not null default '[]'::jsonb,
  is_active boolean not null default true,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  constraint plans_features_array check (jsonb_typeof(features) = 'array')
);

create index if not exists idx_plans_active on public.plans(is_active);

insert into public.plans (
  plan_id,
  name,
  description,
  price_idr_direct,
  play_product_id,
  duration_days,
  max_devices,
  features,
  is_active
) values
  (
    'basic_monthly',
    'Basic',
    'POS checkout dasar',
    49000,
    'pos_basic_monthly',
    30,
    1,
    '["pos_checkout"]'::jsonb,
    true
  ),
  (
    'pro_monthly',
    'Pro',
    'POS + accounting + FEFO + scanner/OCR',
    149000,
    'pos_pro_monthly',
    30,
    3,
    '["pos_checkout","accounting","fefo","barcode_scan","ocr"]'::jsonb,
    true
  ),
  (
    'enterprise_monthly',
    'Enterprise',
    'Semua fitur termasuk multi-cabang dan API',
    299000,
    'pos_enterprise_monthly',
    30,
    10,
    '["pos_checkout","accounting","fefo","barcode_scan","ocr","multi_cabang","api"]'::jsonb,
    true
  )
on conflict (plan_id) do update set
  name = excluded.name,
  description = excluded.description,
  price_idr_direct = excluded.price_idr_direct,
  play_product_id = excluded.play_product_id,
  duration_days = excluded.duration_days,
  max_devices = excluded.max_devices,
  features = excluded.features,
  is_active = excluded.is_active,
  updated_at = now();

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Subscriptions
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create table if not exists public.subscriptions (
  sub_id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id uuid not null references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,
  plan_id text not null references public.plans(plan_id),
  status text not null,
  payment_provider text not null,

  -- Google Play
  play_purchase_token text unique,
  play_order_id text,

  -- Midtrans
  midtrans_order_id text unique,
  midtrans_transaction_id text,

  current_period_start timestamptz not null default now(),
  current_period_end timestamptz not null,
  grace_period_end timestamptz,
  auto_renewing boolean not null default true,

  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  cancelled_at timestamptz,

  constraint subscriptions_status_check
    check (status in ('pending','active','past_due','expired','cancelled')),
  constraint subscriptions_provider_check
    check (payment_provider in ('play_billing','midtrans')),
  constraint subscriptions_period_check
    check (current_period_end >= current_period_start),
  constraint subscriptions_grace_check
    check (grace_period_end is null or grace_period_end >= current_period_end),
  constraint subscriptions_provider_identity_check
    check (
      (payment_provider = 'play_billing' and play_purchase_token is not null)
      or
      (payment_provider = 'midtrans' and midtrans_order_id is not null)
    )
);

create index if not exists idx_subscriptions_user on public.subscriptions(user_id);
create index if not exists idx_subscriptions_user_period on public.subscriptions(user_id, current_period_end desc);
create index if not exists idx_subscriptions_status on public.subscriptions(status);
create index if not exists idx_subscriptions_provider on public.subscriptions(payment_provider);
create index if not exists idx_subscriptions_grace on public.subscriptions(grace_period_end);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Webhook / lifecycle audit
-- event_key is the idempotency key:
--   Play RTDN     -> Pub/Sub messageId
--   Midtrans      -> order_id:transaction_status:transaction_id
--   Play verify   -> verify:purchaseToken:expiryTime
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create table if not exists public.subscription_events (
  event_id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  sub_id uuid references public.subscriptions(sub_id) on delete set null,
  provider text not null,
  event_type text not null,
  event_key text unique,
  payload jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb,
  occurred_at timestamptz,
  received_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  constraint subscription_events_provider_check
    check (provider in ('play_billing','midtrans','system'))
);

create index if not exists idx_subscription_events_sub on public.subscription_events(sub_id, received_at desc);
create index if not exists idx_subscription_events_provider on public.subscription_events(provider, received_at desc);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Devices
-- device_id should be a random UUID generated once on device and kept in
-- flutter_secure_storage. No hardware permission is required.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create table if not exists public.devices (
  device_id text primary key,
  user_id uuid not null references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,
  platform text not null,
  app_version text,
  last_license_check timestamptz,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  constraint devices_platform_check
    check (platform in ('android_play','android_direct'))
);

create index if not exists idx_devices_user on public.devices(user_id);
create index if not exists idx_devices_user_platform on public.devices(user_id, platform);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- updated_at triggers
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
drop trigger if exists trg_plans_updated_at on public.plans;
create trigger trg_plans_updated_at
before update on public.plans
for each row execute function public.set_updated_at();

drop trigger if exists trg_subscriptions_updated_at on public.subscriptions;
create trigger trg_subscriptions_updated_at
before update on public.subscriptions
for each row execute function public.set_updated_at();

drop trigger if exists trg_devices_updated_at on public.devices;
create trigger trg_devices_updated_at
before update on public.devices
for each row execute function public.set_updated_at();

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Transactional device binding.
-- Existing registered devices remain allowed even if the plan is later
-- downgraded below the current device count; NEW devices are rejected.
-- The advisory lock prevents two simultaneous license checks from both
-- slipping past max_devices.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create or replace function public.bind_license_device(
  p_user_id uuid,
  p_device_id text,
  p_platform text,
  p_app_version text,
  p_plan_id text
)
returns void
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
declare
  v_max_devices integer;
  v_count integer;
  v_owner uuid;
begin
  if p_platform not in ('android_play','android_direct') then
    raise exception using errcode = '22023', message = 'invalid_platform';
  end if;

  -- Serialize device enrollment per user.
  perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(p_user_id::text, 0));

  select user_id into v_owner
  from public.devices
  where device_id = p_device_id;

  if v_owner is not null and v_owner <> p_user_id then
    raise exception using errcode = 'P0001', message = 'device_bound_to_other_user';
  end if;

  if v_owner = p_user_id then
    update public.devices
    set platform = p_platform,
        app_version = p_app_version,
        last_license_check = now()
    where device_id = p_device_id;
    return;
  end if;

  select max_devices into v_max_devices
  from public.plans
  where plan_id = p_plan_id;

  if v_max_devices is null then
    raise exception using errcode = 'P0001', message = 'plan_not_found';
  end if;

  select count(*)::integer into v_count
  from public.devices
  where user_id = p_user_id;

  if v_count >= v_max_devices then
    raise exception using errcode = 'P0001', message = 'device_limit_exceeded';
  end if;

  insert into public.devices (
    device_id,
    user_id,
    platform,
    app_version,
    last_license_check
  ) values (
    p_device_id,
    p_user_id,
    p_platform,
    p_app_version,
    now()
  );
end;
$$;

revoke all on function public.bind_license_device(uuid,text,text,text,text) from public;
revoke all on function public.bind_license_device(uuid,text,text,text,text) from anon;
revoke all on function public.bind_license_device(uuid,text,text,text,text) from authenticated;
grant execute on function public.bind_license_device(uuid,text,text,text,text) to service_role;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Hourly reconciliation function.
-- The payment webhooks remain the primary source of truth. This function is a
-- safety net for delayed/missed webhooks and enforces the local 3-day grace.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create or replace function public.reconcile_subscription_expiry()
returns jsonb
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
declare
  v_past_due integer := 0;
  v_expired integer := 0;
begin
  update public.subscriptions
  set status = 'past_due',
      grace_period_end = coalesce(grace_period_end, current_period_end + interval '3 days')
  where status in ('active','cancelled')
    and now() > current_period_end
    and now() <= coalesce(grace_period_end, current_period_end + interval '3 days');
  get diagnostics v_past_due = row_count;

  update public.subscriptions
  set status = 'expired',
      auto_renewing = false
  where status in ('pending','active','past_due','cancelled')
    and now() > coalesce(grace_period_end, current_period_end + interval '3 days');
  get diagnostics v_expired = row_count;

  insert into public.subscription_events (
    provider,
    event_type,
    event_key,
    payload,
    occurred_at
  ) values (
    'system',
    'hourly_reconcile',
    'cron:' || date_trunc('hour', now())::text,
    jsonb_build_object('past_due', v_past_due, 'expired', v_expired),
    now()
  )
  on conflict (event_key) do nothing;

  return jsonb_build_object('past_due', v_past_due, 'expired', v_expired);
end;
$$;

revoke all on function public.reconcile_subscription_expiry() from public;
revoke all on function public.reconcile_subscription_expiry() from anon;
revoke all on function public.reconcile_subscription_expiry() from authenticated;
grant execute on function public.reconcile_subscription_expiry() to service_role;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- RLS: subscription state is never writable by the app directly.
-- Active plans may be read by authenticated clients, although the provided
-- backend also exposes /billing/plans.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
alter table public.plans enable row level security;
alter table public.subscriptions enable row level security;
alter table public.subscription_events enable row level security;
alter table public.devices enable row level security;

drop policy if exists plans_read_active on public.plans;
create policy plans_read_active
on public.plans
for select
to authenticated
using (is_active = true);

-- No direct client policies for subscriptions/events/devices.
-- Edge Functions use SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY and bypass RLS.

commit;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- SCHEDULING (run once after enabling Supabase Cron / pg_cron):
--
--   select cron.schedule(
--     'dual-rail-hourly-reconcile',
--     '5 * * * *',
--     $$select public.reconcile_subscription_expiry();$$
--   );
--
-- If pg_cron is not enabled in your project, enable "Cron" in Supabase first.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

create table public.product_master (
  product_id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  tenant_id uuid not null references public.accounting_tenants(tenant_id) on delete restrict,
  sku text not null,
  barcode text,
  name_id text not null,
  price bigint not null,
  ppn_exempt boolean not null default false,
  track_expiry boolean not null default false,
  min_shelf_life_days integer not null default 0,
  is_active boolean not null default true,
  version bigint not null default 1,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  constraint product_master_sku_not_blank check (length(btrim(sku)) between 1 and 120),
  constraint product_master_barcode_not_blank check (barcode is null or length(btrim(barcode)) between 1 and 120),
  constraint product_master_name_not_blank check (length(btrim(name_id)) between 1 and 240),
  constraint product_master_price_nonnegative check (price >= 0),
  constraint product_master_shelf_life_nonnegative check (min_shelf_life_days >= 0),
  constraint product_master_expiry_policy check (track_expiry or min_shelf_life_days = 0),
  constraint product_master_version_positive check (version > 0),
  constraint product_master_tenant_product_unique unique (tenant_id, product_id),
  constraint product_master_tenant_sku_unique unique (tenant_id, sku)
);

create unique index product_master_tenant_barcode_unique
  on public.product_master (tenant_id, barcode)
  where barcode is not null;

create index product_master_tenant_active_idx
  on public.product_master (tenant_id, is_active, updated_at, product_id);

alter table public.product_master enable row level security;

revoke all on table public.product_master from anon, authenticated;
grant select on table public.product_master to authenticated;
grant select, insert, update, delete on table public.product_master to service_role;

create policy product_master_read_active_membership
on public.product_master
for select
to authenticated
using (
  (select auth.uid()) is not null
  and exists (
    select 1
    from public.accounting_memberships membership
    where membership.tenant_id = product_master.tenant_id
      and membership.user_id = (select auth.uid())
      and membership.is_active
  )
);

comment on table public.product_master is
  'Authoritative tenant-scoped product master. Inventory quantities/lots are intentionally separate.';
comment on column public.product_master.version is
  'Server-authoritative monotonic product version; writers must increment on each semantic update.';

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_effective_config(p_tenant text, p_device text, p_service text) RETURNS jsonb AS $$
DECLARE result jsonb := '{}'::jsonb; r record; BEGIN FOR r IN SELECT value FROM app_config WHERE key IN ('global','tenant:'||p_tenant,'tenant:'||p_tenant||':service:'||p_service,'device:'||p_device) ORDER BY CASE WHEN key='global' THEN 1 WHEN key='tenant:'||p_tenant THEN 2 WHEN key='tenant:'||p_tenant||':service:'||p_service THEN 3 WHEN key='device:'||p_device THEN 4 END LOOP result := result || r.value; END LOOP; RETURN result; END; $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER;

create table public.accounting_transaction_evidence (
  evidence_id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  tenant_id uuid not null references public.accounting_tenants(tenant_id),
  transaction_ref text not null,
  transaction_type text not null check (transaction_type in ('JUAL_TUNAI','JUAL_QRIS','JUAL_TRANSFER','JUAL_KREDIT','BELI_KREDIT','BAYAR_VENDOR','RETUR_PENJUALAN','STOCK_OPNAME')),
  business_date date not null,
  request_fingerprint jsonb not null check (jsonb_typeof(request_fingerprint)='object'),
  facts_snapshot jsonb not null check (jsonb_typeof(facts_snapshot)='object'),
  tax_snapshot jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb check (jsonb_typeof(tax_snapshot)='object'),
  journal_id uuid not null references public.accounting_journals(journal_id),
  actor_user_id uuid not null references auth.users(id),
  device_id text not null check (length(btrim(device_id))>=1),
  app_version text not null check (length(btrim(app_version))>=1),
  reason text not null check (length(btrim(reason))>=3),
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  unique(tenant_id,transaction_ref)
);

create table public.sale_line_evidence (
  tenant_id uuid not null,
  transaction_ref text not null,
  line_key text not null,
  product_id uuid null,
  line_kind text not null check (line_kind in ('STOCK','SERVICE')),
  quantity bigint not null check (quantity>0),
  revenue_account text not null references public.accounting_coa(account_code),
  dpp bigint not null check (dpp>=0),
  vat_amount bigint not null check (vat_amount>=0),
  gross_amount bigint not null check (gross_amount>=0),
  original_cogs bigint not null check (original_cogs>=0),
  tax_snapshot jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb check (jsonb_typeof(tax_snapshot)='object'),
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  primary key(tenant_id,transaction_ref,line_key),
  foreign key(tenant_id,transaction_ref) references public.accounting_transaction_evidence(tenant_id,transaction_ref),
  foreign key(tenant_id,product_id) references public.product_master(tenant_id,product_id),
  check ((line_kind='STOCK' and product_id is not null and original_cogs>0) or (line_kind='SERVICE' and product_id is null and original_cogs=0))
);

create table public.sale_return_line_evidence (
  tenant_id uuid not null,
  return_transaction_ref text not null,
  original_transaction_ref text not null,
  line_key text not null,
  quantity bigint not null check (quantity>0),
  dpp_reversed bigint not null check (dpp_reversed>=0),
  vat_reversed bigint not null check (vat_reversed>=0),
  cogs_restored bigint not null check (cogs_restored>=0),
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  primary key(tenant_id,return_transaction_ref,line_key),
  foreign key(tenant_id,return_transaction_ref) references public.accounting_transaction_evidence(tenant_id,transaction_ref),
  foreign key(tenant_id,original_transaction_ref,line_key) references public.sale_line_evidence(tenant_id,transaction_ref,line_key)
);

create table public.tax_parties (
  tenant_id uuid not null references public.accounting_tenants(tenant_id),
  party_id uuid not null default gen_random_uuid(),
  party_kind text not null check (party_kind in ('SELF','CUSTOMER','VENDOR','EMPLOYEE')),
  display_name text not null check (length(btrim(display_name))>=1),
  npwp text,
  nik text,
  nitku text,
  is_pkp boolean not null default false,
  tax_regime text not null,
  legal_basis text not null check (length(btrim(legal_basis))>=3),
  taxpayer_type text not null,
  valid_from date not null,
  valid_to date,
  certificate_status text not null,
  turnover_eligibility boolean,
  tax_object text,
  metadata jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb check (jsonb_typeof(metadata)='object'),
  actor_user_id uuid not null references auth.users(id),
  device_id text not null check (length(btrim(device_id))>=1),
  reason text not null check (length(btrim(reason))>=3),
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  primary key(tenant_id,party_id),
  check (valid_to is null or valid_to>=valid_from)
);

create table public.tax_documents (
  tax_document_id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  tenant_id uuid not null references public.accounting_tenants(tenant_id),
  document_type text not null check (document_type in ('VAT_OUTPUT','VAT_INPUT','VAT_RETURN','VAT_REPLACEMENT','VAT_CANCELLATION','PPH21_26','PPH23_UNIFICATION','PPH_FINAL')),
  document_number text,
  transaction_ref text not null,
  reference_document_id uuid references public.tax_documents(tax_document_id),
  counterparty_id uuid,
  business_date date not null,
  vat_transaction_code text,
  facility_context text,
  dpp bigint not null default 0 check (dpp>=0),
  tax_amount bigint not null default 0 check (tax_amount>=0),
  gross_amount bigint not null default 0 check (gross_amount>=0),
  tax_rate_snapshot jsonb not null check (jsonb_typeof(tax_rate_snapshot)='object'),
  legal_rule_snapshot jsonb not null check (jsonb_typeof(legal_rule_snapshot)='object'),
  invoice_status text not null default 'PENDING' check (invoice_status in ('PENDING','VALID','INVALID')),
  creditable_input_vat boolean not null default false,
  status text not null default 'DRAFT' check (status in ('DRAFT','VALIDATED','SUBMITTED','ACCEPTED','REJECTED','CANCELLED','REPLACED','REPORTED')),
  journal_id uuid references public.accounting_journals(journal_id),
  coretax_reference text,
  sealed_hash text,
  actor_user_id uuid not null references auth.users(id),
  device_id text not null check (length(btrim(device_id))>=1),
  reason text not null check (length(btrim(reason))>=3),
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  unique(tenant_id,document_type,transaction_ref),
  foreign key(tenant_id,counterparty_id) references public.tax_parties(tenant_id,party_id),
  check (vat_transaction_code is null or vat_transaction_code ~ '^[0-9]{2}$')
);

create table public.tax_document_events (
  event_id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  tax_document_id uuid not null references public.tax_documents(tax_document_id),
  tenant_id uuid not null references public.accounting_tenants(tenant_id),
  event_type text not null,
  details jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb check (jsonb_typeof(details)='object'),
  actor_user_id uuid not null references auth.users(id),
  device_id text not null check (length(btrim(device_id))>=1),
  reason text not null check (length(btrim(reason))>=3),
  occurred_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create table public.coretax_outbox (
  outbox_id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  tax_document_id uuid not null references public.tax_documents(tax_document_id),
  tenant_id uuid not null references public.accounting_tenants(tenant_id),
  xml_template_code text not null,
  xml_payload text not null,
  payload_sha256 text not null,

create or replace function private.umkm_gross_turnover_between(p_tenant_id uuid,p_from date,p_to date)
returns bigint language sql stable security definer set search_path=''
as $$
  with base_lines as (
    select
      s.tenant_id,s.transaction_ref,s.line_key,s.line_kind,s.service_profile_id,s.quantity,s.list_amount,s.taxable,s.tax_snapshot,
      e.business_date,e.facts_snapshot,
      case when s.line_kind='SERVICE' then coalesce(sp.umkm_final_eligible,false) else true end as umkm_eligible,
      case
        when s.taxable and coalesce((e.facts_snapshot->>'prices_include_vat')::boolean,false)
          then round(s.list_amount::numeric/(1+coalesce((s.tax_snapshot->>'effective_rate')::numeric,0)))::bigint
        else s.list_amount
      end as gross_before_discount_ex_vat
    from public.sale_line_evidence s
    join public.accounting_transaction_evidence e on e.tenant_id=s.tenant_id and e.transaction_ref=s.transaction_ref
    left join public.service_tax_profiles sp on sp.tenant_id=s.tenant_id and sp.service_profile_id=s.service_profile_id
    where s.tenant_id=p_tenant_id and e.transaction_type in ('JUAL_TUNAI','JUAL_QRIS','JUAL_TRANSFER','JUAL_KREDIT')
  ), sales_period as (
    select * from base_lines where business_date between p_from and p_to
  ), returns_period as (
    select r.tenant_id,r.original_transaction_ref,r.line_key,er.business_date as return_date,
           round(bl.gross_before_discount_ex_vat::numeric*r.quantity::numeric/bl.quantity::numeric)::bigint as gross_reversed,
           bl.umkm_eligible
    from public.sale_return_line_evidence r
    join public.accounting_transaction_evidence er on er.tenant_id=r.tenant_id and er.transaction_ref=r.return_transaction_ref
    join base_lines bl on bl.tenant_id=r.tenant_id and bl.transaction_ref=r.original_transaction_ref and bl.line_key=r.line_key
    where r.tenant_id=p_tenant_id and er.business_date between p_from and p_to
  )
  select greatest(
    coalesce((select sum(gross_before_discount_ex_vat) from sales_period where umkm_eligible),0)
    - coalesce((select sum(gross_reversed) from returns_period where umkm_eligible),0),0
  )::bigint;
$$;
revoke all on function private.umkm_gross_turnover_between(uuid,date,date) from public,anon,authenticated,service_role;

begin

entries.sql:
-- Stress-test observability and journal balance invariant.
-- Apply only to an isolated Supabase clone after inspecting its existing data.
-- The validated CHECK fails closed if any existing journal is unbalanced.

begin;

alter table public.accounting_journals
  add constraint chk_balance
  check (total_debit = total_credit);

-- The uniqueness scope is (tenant_id, transaction_ref), so group both columns.
-- Grouping only transaction_ref would false-positive if tenants reuse a reference.
create or replace view public.v_stress_validation
with (security_invoker = true)
as
select
  tenant_id,
  transaction_ref,
  count(*)::bigint as journal_count
from public.accounting_journals
group by tenant_id, transaction_ref
having count(*) > 1;

comment on view public.v_stress_validation is
  'Read-only stress-test validation: returns duplicate (tenant_id, transaction_ref) groups; expected to return zero rows.';

revoke all on table public.v_stress_validation from public, anon, authenticated;
grant select on table public.v_stress_validation to service_role;

commit;

-- 202610100001_fix_outbox_contract.sql
-- Align create_auto_journal RPC success with the POS outbox acknowledgement contract.
-- This migration deliberately does not insert/update/delete/truncate public.app_config.

DO $app_config_guard$
DECLARE
  v_count bigint;
  v_keyset_md5 text;
BEGIN
  SELECT count(*), md5(string_agg(key, E'\n' ORDER BY key))
    INTO v_count, v_keyset_md5
  FROM public.app_config;

  IF v_count <> 352 OR v_keyset_md5 <> '1fd3d64219ecc7c333453c20da80e295' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION
      'app_config invariant failed; expected 352 keys and MD5 1fd3d64219ecc7c333453c20da80e295, got count=% md5=%',
      v_count, v_keyset_md5
      USING ERRCODE = '23514';
  END IF;
END;
$app_config_guard$;

COMMENT ON COLUMN public.transaction_type_map.debit_account IS
  'Primary debit account for the canonical flow; NULL means the builder resolves the account from transaction facts.';
COMMENT ON COLUMN public.transaction_type_map.credit_account IS
  'Primary credit account for the canonical flow; NULL means the builder resolves the account from transaction facts.';

-- Exactly 21 canonical RPC input types are mapped here. These are p_transaction_type
-- values accepted by public.create_auto_journal, not source_type outputs such as pos_sale.
-- Added rows preserve the v_source values emitted by the live RPC and allowed by post_journal.
-- Account columns stay NULL where the existing builder resolves the side from facts.

  ('SETOR_MODAL_OWNER',    'manual',                   NULL,     '3-3010'),
  ('BELI_ASET_TUNAI',      'fixed_asset_acquisition',  '1-1060', NULL),
  ('PENYUSUTAN_BULANAN',  'fixed_asset_depreciation', '6-6060', '1-1070'),
  ('PRIVE_OWNER',          'manual',                   '3-3030', NULL),

  ('STOCK_OPNAME',         'manual',                   NULL,     NULL),

  ('BAYAR_PPH23_15',      'supplier_payment',         NULL,     NULL),
  ('GAJI_BULANAN',         'payroll_accrual',           NULL,     NULL),

DO $transaction_type_map_guard$

$transaction_type_map_guard$;

-- Backfill historical posted journals without inventing pos_sale as an input type.
-- POS sales are classified from the tender account in the original journal fingerprint;
-- reversals inherit the original sale's input type while retaining source_type='reversal'.
-- Rows are acknowledged only when header totals and persisted journal-line totals balance.
WITH line_totals AS (
  SELECT
    j.journal_id,
    count(l.line_id) AS line_count,
    COALESCE(sum(l.debit), 0) AS line_debit,
    COALESCE(sum(l.credit), 0) AS line_credit
  FROM public.accounting_journals AS j
  LEFT JOIN public.accounting_journal_lines AS l
    ON l.journal_id = j.journal_id
  GROUP BY j.journal_id
),
valid_journals AS (
  SELECT
    j.*,
    COALESCE(original.request_fingerprint, j.request_fingerprint) AS source_fingerprint
  FROM public.accounting_journals AS j
  JOIN line_totals AS lt
    ON lt.journal_id = j.journal_id
  LEFT JOIN public.accounting_journals AS original
    ON original.journal_id = j.reversal_of
  WHERE j.total_debit = j.total_credit
    AND lt.line_count >= 2
    AND lt.line_debit = j.total_debit
    AND lt.line_credit = j.total_credit
),
classified_journals AS (
  SELECT
    v.*,
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(NULLIF(upper(btrim(v.request_fingerprint ->> 'transaction_type')), ''), 'POS_SALE'),
      CASE
        WHEN v.source_type IN ('pos_sale', 'reversal') THEN tender.transaction_type
      END
    ) AS inferred_transaction_type
  FROM valid_journals AS v
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT CASE
      WHEN bool_or(line.value ->> 'account_code' = '1-1010'
                   AND COALESCE(NULLIF(line.value ->> 'debit', '')::bigint, 0) > 0)
        THEN 'JUAL_TUNAI'
      WHEN bool_or(line.value ->> 'account_code' = '1-1020'
                   AND COALESCE(NULLIF(line.value ->> 'debit', '')::bigint, 0) > 0)
        THEN 'JUAL_QRIS'
      WHEN bool_or(line.value ->> 'account_code' = '1-1030'
                   AND COALESCE(NULLIF(line.value ->> 'debit', '')::bigint, 0) > 0)
        THEN 'JUAL_TRANSFER'
      WHEN bool_or(line.value ->> 'account_code' = '1-1050'
                   AND COALESCE(NULLIF(line.value ->> 'debit', '')::bigint, 0) > 0)
        THEN 'JUAL_KREDIT'
    END AS transaction_type
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(
      CASE
        WHEN jsonb_typeof(v.source_fingerprint -> 'lines') = 'array'
          THEN v.source_fingerprint -> 'lines'
        ELSE '[]'::jsonb
      END
    ) AS line(value)
  ) AS tender ON true
)
INSERT INTO private.pos_outbox
  (id, tenant_id, transaction_ref, p_transaction_type, source_type, payload, acked_at, created_at)
SELECT
  gen_random_uuid(),
  j.tenant_id,
  j.transaction_ref,
  j.inferred_transaction_type,
  j.source_type,
  jsonb_build_object(
    'migration_backfill', true,
    'journal_id', j.journal_id,
    'reversal_of', j.reversal_of,
    'request_fingerprint', j.request_fingerprint
  ),
  now(),
  j.posted_at
FROM classified_journals AS j
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM public.transaction_type_map AS m
  WHERE m.p_transaction_type = j.inferred_transaction_type
)
ON CONFLICT (transaction_ref) DO NOTHING;

-- Also acknowledge pre-existing outbox rows only when the matching posted journal
-- and all persisted lines are balanced. No status is changed for an unbalanced journal.
WITH line_totals AS (
  SELECT
    j.journal_id,
    count(l.line_id) AS line_count,
    COALESCE(sum(l.debit), 0) AS line_debit,
    COALESCE(sum(l.credit), 0) AS line_credit
  FROM public.accounting_journals AS j
  LEFT JOIN public.accounting_journal_lines AS l
    ON l.journal_id = j.journal_id
  GROUP BY j.journal_id
)
UPDATE private.pos_outbox AS o
SET acked_at = now(),
    source_type = j.source_type
FROM public.accounting_journals AS j
JOIN line_totals AS lt
  ON lt.journal_id = j.journal_id
WHERE o.tenant_id = j.tenant_id
  AND o.transaction_ref = j.transaction_ref
  AND o.acked_at IS NULL
  AND j.total_debit = j.total_credit
  AND lt.line_count >= 2
  AND lt.line_debit = j.total_debit
  AND lt.line_credit = j.total_credit;

-- Fail closed if the backfill did not produce exactly one acknowledged outbox row
-- for each currently valid posted journal, or if any acknowledgement has no valid journal.
DO $outbox_acceptance_guard$
DECLARE
  v_valid_journals bigint;
  v_acked_outbox bigint;
BEGIN
  SELECT count(*) INTO v_valid_journals
  FROM public.accounting_journals AS j
  WHERE j.total_debit = j.total_credit
    AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.accounting_journal_lines AS l
         WHERE l.journal_id = j.journal_id) >= 2
    AND (SELECT COALESCE(sum(l.debit), 0) FROM public.accounting_journal_lines AS l
         WHERE l.journal_id = j.journal_id) = j.total_debit
    AND (SELECT COALESCE(sum(l.credit), 0) FROM public.accounting_journal_lines AS l
         WHERE l.journal_id = j.journal_id) = j.total_credit;

  SELECT count(*) INTO v_acked_outbox
  FROM private.pos_outbox
  WHERE acked_at IS NOT NULL;

  IF v_acked_outbox <> v_valid_journals THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION
      'outbox acceptance failed: acknowledged rows=% valid balanced journals=%',
      v_acked_outbox, v_valid_journals
      USING ERRCODE = '23514';
  END IF;

  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.accounting_journals AS j
    WHERE j.total_debit = j.total_credit
      AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.accounting_journal_lines AS l
           WHERE l.journal_id = j.journal_id) >= 2
      AND (SELECT COALESCE(sum(l.debit), 0) FROM public.accounting_journal_lines AS l
           WHERE l.journal_id = j.journal_id) = j.total_debit
      AND (SELECT COALESCE(sum(l.credit), 0) FROM public.accounting_journal_lines AS l
           WHERE l.journal_id = j.journal_id) = j.total_credit
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM private.pos_outbox AS o
        WHERE o.tenant_id = j.tenant_id
          AND o.transaction_ref = j.transaction_ref
          AND o.acked_at IS NOT NULL
      )
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'outbox acceptance failed: a valid journal has no acknowledged outbox row'
      USING ERRCODE = '23514';
  END IF;
END;
$outbox_acceptance_guard$;

-- Patch the existing RPC in place by replacing only its unique successful tail.
-- This deliberately fails closed if the deployed function differs from the expected contract.
DO $patch_create_auto_journal$
DECLARE
  v_definition text;
  v_anchor text := $anchor$
  insert into private.audit_logs(tenant_id,actor_id,device_id,source,reason,action) values(p_tenant_id::text,v_actor,btrim(p_device_id),'auto_journal:'||lower(v_type),btrim(p_reason),'success');
  return v_journal;
end;
$anchor$;
  v_replacement text := $replacement$
  insert into private.audit_logs(tenant_id,actor_id,device_id,source,reason,action) values(p_tenant_id::text,v_actor,btrim(p_device_id),'auto_journal:'||lower(v_type),btrim(p_reason),'success');

  -- Ensure an outbox row exists in the same transaction. If a caller pre-enqueued
  -- the transaction, preserve its row and acknowledge only the matching contract.
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.transaction_type_map AS m
    WHERE m.p_transaction_type = v_type
      AND m.source_type = v_source
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'transaction_type_map_missing_or_source_mismatch'
      USING ERRCODE = '23514';
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO private.pos_outbox
    (id, tenant_id, transaction_ref, p_transaction_type, source_type, payload, acked_at, created_at)
  SELECT
    gen_random_uuid(),
    p_tenant_id,
    btrim(p_transaction_ref),
    m.p_transaction_type,
    m.source_type,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'journal_id', v_journal,
      'business_date', p_business_date,
      'facts', p_facts,
      'device_id', btrim(p_device_id),
      'app_version', btrim(p_app_version),
      'reason', btrim(p_reason)
    ),
    NULL,
    now()
  FROM public.transaction_type_map AS m
  WHERE m.p_transaction_type = v_type
    AND m.source_type = v_source
  ON CONFLICT (transaction_ref) DO NOTHING;

  UPDATE private.pos_outbox AS o
  SET acked_at = now(),
      source_type = m.source_type
  FROM public.transaction_type_map AS m
  JOIN public.accounting_journals AS j
    ON j.journal_id = v_journal
   AND j.tenant_id = p_tenant_id
   AND j.transaction_ref = btrim(p_transaction_ref)
  WHERE o.tenant_id = p_tenant_id
    AND o.transaction_ref = btrim(p_transaction_ref)
    AND upper(btrim(o.p_transaction_type)) = m.p_transaction_type
    AND m.p_transaction_type = v_type
    AND m.source_type = v_source
    AND j.total_debit = j.total_credit
    AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.accounting_journal_lines AS l
         WHERE l.journal_id = j.journal_id) >= 2
    AND (SELECT COALESCE(sum(l.debit), 0) FROM public.accounting_journal_lines AS l
         WHERE l.journal_id = j.journal_id) = j.total_debit
    AND (SELECT COALESCE(sum(l.credit), 0) FROM public.accounting_journal_lines AS l
         WHERE l.journal_id = j.journal_id) = j.total_credit
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM public.accounting_transaction_evidence AS e
      WHERE e.tenant_id = p_tenant_id
        AND e.transaction_ref = btrim(p_transaction_ref)
        AND e.journal_id = v_journal
    )
    AND o.acked_at IS NULL;

  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM private.pos_outbox AS o
    WHERE o.tenant_id = p_tenant_id
      AND o.transaction_ref = btrim(p_transaction_ref)
      AND upper(btrim(o.p_transaction_type)) = v_type
      AND o.source_type = v_source
      AND o.acked_at IS NOT NULL
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'pos_outbox_acknowledgement_failed'
      USING ERRCODE = '23514';
  END IF;

  return v_journal;
end;
$replacement$;
BEGIN
  SELECT pg_get_functiondef(
    'public.create_auto_journal(uuid,text,text,date,jsonb,text,text,text)'::regprocedure
  )
  INTO v_definition;

  IF v_definition IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'public.create_auto_journal RPC was not found'
      USING ERRCODE = '42883';
  END IF;

  IF position('UPDATE private.pos_outbox' IN v_definition) > 0 THEN
    -- Idempotent rerun: the RPC already contains the contract patch.
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  IF position(v_anchor IN v_definition) = 0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION
      'create_auto_journal tail did not match expected audited success path; refusing to patch a different function body'
      USING ERRCODE = '23514';
  END IF;

  v_definition := replace(v_definition, v_anchor, v_replacement);
  EXECUTE v_definition;
END;
$patch_create_auto_journal$;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW public.v_outbox_unacked
WITH (security_invoker = true)
AS
SELECT *
FROM private.pos_outbox
WHERE acked_at IS NULL;

REVOKE ALL ON TABLE public.v_outbox_unacked FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
GRANT SELECT ON TABLE public.v_outbox_unacked TO service_role;
